drivingQuestion: Why the priesthood is included only in the second confession
outcomeNote: the priest confesses for the priesthood only after his own atonement

segments.he: תָּנָא דְּבֵי רַבִּי יִשְׁמָעֵאל, כָּךְ הִיא מִדַּת הַדִּין נוֹתֶנֶת: מוּטָב יָבֹא זַכַּאי וִיכַפֵּר עַל הַחַיָּיב, וְאַל יָבֹא חַיָּיב וִיכַפֵּר עַל הַחַיָּיב.
segments.en: «The school of Rabbi Yishmael taught: That is» the method to which «the attribute of justice lends» itself: «Better that an innocent person should come and gain atonement on behalf of the guilty, and a guilty person should not come and gain atonement on behalf of» another «guilty person.» At the first confession, the High Priest has still not achieved atonement for himself. Therefore, it is more appropriate for him to wait until the second confession to seek atonement for the priesthood.
